name: Generated template deck appears in the deck list and can be deleted with confirmation
description: A newly generated template deck shows up in the Template studio deck list with an engine badge, and deleting it asks for confirmation then removes it.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and click the 'Template studio — HTML decks' mode switch tab.
Select any available template card, type the brief 'Podcast launch plan: format, episodes, distribution' and click the generate button.

Wait for the deck viewer to open (allow up to 180 seconds), note the deck title, then return to the Template studio landing area (use back/landing navigation, not the browser back button away from the app).
Scroll to the template decks list section on the Template studio page.
Verify the deck list contains the newly generated deck (its title matches what was noted) and shows an engine/template badge on the card.
Click the delete control on that deck's card.
Verify a confirmation dialog appears with 'Cancel' and confirm options.
Verify the deck is still in the list after cancelling.
Click delete again and this time confirm the deletion.
Verify the deck disappears from the list.
